name: @symbiote-native/expo-modules-link
description: Shared postinstall runtime for expo-modules-core wrapper packages (sensors, local-auth, haptics, ...). Registers a package's native Android module into the consuming app's app/build.gradle and MainApplication.kt so a new native module never needs a hand-edit — every wrapper package depends on this and calls it from its own postinstall.
author: Andrey Prokopenko <psevdoproger@gmail.com>
